synthetic: All parameters are synthetic and configurable; they are not empirical statistics about real students.
name: Procedural learner (cohort B: unrecognised errors, neutral learning response)
description: Strong one- and two-step procedures; weak with x on both sides and brackets (systematic errors there). Cohort B: each catalogued misconception is replaced by an error at the same step that OpenPath's teaching taxonomy does not represent (same strength); instruction is understood only from the kind of equations an explanation works through (no title recognition, no misconception targeting).
